summary: Honest dry stop after iter-79 GOAL_ACHIEVED: 0 promotable proposals, docs/goal.md untouched. Data lens — the fresh post-goal scan (state/triad-scan.json 2026-08-14, 110 cells / 50 screened / 3 survivors) returned only downside_vol, atr_pct and hv h60 d10, which are the three WORST max-drawdown cells of all 50 screened (-0.2366 / -0.2496 / -0.2392 vs -0.0859 next worst), each already recorded REJECTED (ops-hardening line 3; mcp-loop lines 13-14), each on its factor's adverse decile side, none pre-registered, hv a closed referee FAIL — and this cycle's Loop mechanics forbid any Evidence Claim / proven-language (AG-1/AG-4/AG-6), so no data pattern is buildable in this goal at all. Vision lens — NO uncovered claim: every Vision sentence (boot to serving in seconds; heavy aggregates computed at ingest and persisted, never on a request path; each page loads only what it needs; UI truthful about backend state incl. background compute; truthful about data jobs; unrestricted chunked memory-bounded backfills), all six Key Capabilities and all six Success Criteria map to a passing journey (J-01/J-03/J-04/J-05/J-06/J-07/J-08/J-09). Structural candidates all resolve to owner-governed decisions, not proposer-autonomous work: B-1107 (bound concurrent background computes) is re-ranked highest with NEW corroborating evidence — iter-72's sustained uvicorn 503 streak on /api/health under CPU-bound compute (perf-budgets Addendum 37) and iter-79's 9.3 s /api/backtest outlier proven to be queue-wait, not compute (lessons.md) — but the owner deferred it on 2026-07-25 and it is still 'Owner-owned, NOT blocking' at close; the rebuild-ignores-range behavior is designed and disclosed in the UI (J-85), not a gap; the remaining items are evidence-capture chores this session's own rules bar from being an iteration goal, and 153 unresolved MINOR ledger entries the owner's 2026-08-13 amendment explicitly de-gated. Two non-promotable records appended to state/enhancement-proposals.jsonl (the re-screen rejection, the B-1107 re-rank) for anti-re-mining and owner record. Restarting the loop was not justified: nothing survives that the project's own governance lets a proposer build.
